status: offline provider and natural provenance/selectivity guardrails verified; full-endpoint power, T2 protocol and pilot lock pending
controlled_metric_unit: one full A-E episode; all four registered A-D checkpoints plus E novel answer must pass
power_simulation_status: draft-001 planning retained; recompute for full-episode endpoint and guardrail before final N
failure_policy: assigned controlled opportunity scores zero; C0 BRI not applicable; natural zero opportunities undefined
multiplicity: Holm FWER 0.05 across three confirmatory contrasts
false_retraction_definition: registered oracle-supported proposition not retained as supported with identical ID/proposition; includes downgrade, disappearance and redefinition, not only explicit refuted
guardrail_denominator: all preassigned controlled A-D claim slots whose oracle status at that stage is supported; independent of model output, completion and previous asserted status
guardrail_unknown_policy: worst case counts every supported slot at a technically failed or malformed snapshot as loss; conditional completed-stage rate is descriptive only
guardrail_world_aggregation: pool losses and registered supported slots across assigned episodes/repeats within each world, then equally weight paired world rates

natural_metrics.opportunity: observed pre-update causal root with dependent claims whose oracle epistemic status changes under the assigned evidence update
natural_metrics.revision_credit: correct current statuses, sound current bases, all inherited identities and exact version/hash/origin/reasons, successful adjacent publications and unbroken observed history
natural_metrics.unreadable_successor: known predecessor opportunity remains and receives zero credit
natural_metrics.unreadable_predecessor: denominator unknown; aggregate rate undefined, known-subset count/rate labelled separately
natural_metrics.C0: no inherited revision or preservation denominator
natural_metrics.post_update_integrity: descriptive only when an opportunity is observed; requires B-D evidence/history integrity, all technical stages and justified E answer; never controlled BRI

public_hash_utility: hash_claims: identical in all conditions, supplied JSON only, no private state; account all calls
live_gates: final preregistration and immutable execution binding
